mapper.select: SELECT fdp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, fdp.PLEDGE_NUMBER PLEDGE_NUMBER, fdp.PLEDGE_RATIO PLEDGE_RATIO, fdp.PLEDGE_AMT PLEDGE_AMT, fdp.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdp where fdp.FINPROD_ID = #{skuId}

SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, tpda.ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, tpd.PS PS, tpd.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, tpd.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, tpd.CCY CCY, tpd.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, tpd.SHARE_AMT SHARE_AMT, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, #{YES_OR_NO_N} isBottom FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04}) and tpd.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{executeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{status} and tpd.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N}

SELECT rvas.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.CCY ccy, rvas.SECURITY_QUANTITY*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY shareAmt, CASE WHEN fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN rvas.SECURITY_QUANTITY*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY ELSE rvas.UNIT_COST*temp.AMOUNT/rvsas.SECURITY_QUANTITY END tradeAmt, temp.FINPROD_ID pFinprodId, #{YES_OR_NO_Y} isBottom, #{ps} ps FROM ( SELECT psp.PORTFOLIO_ID, psp.FINPROD_ID, psp.CDATE, SUM(psp.AMOUNT) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_02} where psp.CDATE = to_date(#{executeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY psp.PORTFOLIO_ID, psp.FINPROD_ID，psp.CDATE) temp INNER JOIN RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB rvsas ON rvsas.PTL_ID = temp.PORTFOLIO_ID AND rvsas.VAL_DATE = temp.CDATE-1 INNER JOIN RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB rvas ON rvas.PTL_ID = rvsas.PTL_ID AND rvas.VAL_DATE = rvsas.VAL_DATE AND rvas.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = rvas.FINPROD_ID
